title: First guitar, violin lessons and learning to count time
summary: He started on guitar self-taught, then took violin lessons from an old professor, first spending months on counting 'division' with hand and foot.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: You made it before Christmas. Yeah. What was the first instrument you took up as you started on violin or trumpet?

Guitar. Guitar, the first instrument. Did you have any lessons on it or just pick it up? No, just picked it up. And violin, I take lessons. You took lessons on that? Yeah, I take lessons from the old professor from the French Opry. Jimmy Fallow, he died. He was taking lessons. And when he takes his lesson that evening, I'll go to him and take lessons from him.
And he'll give you the same lesson then? Same lesson, yeah.

Remember you told me that before, right? Yeah. And so… Went right through the same book then as he did. Yeah. Well, then before I take up my violin, I take the lesson for about six months. Division. Division. Oh, just counting the time? Just counting the time, Division, yeah. And did you have to sing along with the music to learn that? No. No. Just like, Do Re Mi For Soul, I Say Do. Yeah. That's all right. Yeah. You see, I was being silent. Do Re Mi For Soul, I Say Do. Just counting it out with my hand. Just counting it out with my hand. Like the conductor of an artist. Yeah. Yeah. Now, you see, these days, one, two, and three, one, two, and three, but I didn't… No, you like that. Do Re Mi For Soul, I Say Do.
Well, let me see, I had one down, one to the right, one back to the left, and then…

That's right. Do Re Mi For Soul, see? It's a… you know, in your method, it's got the… Little arrows. And arrows. Yes, I've seen those. You see them? Yes, I've seen them. The ABC book, they used to have one dollar. You can't get them no more.
That was the method you used?
Yeah, one dollar. And it was a book like that. Oh, yeah. Yeah. And I used to, you know, one, two, one, two, one, two. You see? Yes. One, two, three. One, two, three. Yes. Wall side, one, two, three.
Yes. I'm wondering, did you pat your foot with that or just use your hand?

Well, after I knowed with my hand, I used my feet. See? One, two, three. One, two, three. You see? Same thing with your foot, man. One, two, three, four. One, two, three, four. See? One, two, one, two, three. One, two, three. One, two, three. And you used your foot in the same direction. Oh, yeah. Yeah. You see? Just like you would the baton when you direct an orchestra. Yeah. The same thing. You see?
And you did that for six months before you took up the violin.
